name: Xu Hang
evidence: Master’s degree, Biomedical Engineering, Department of Electrical Engineering, Tsinghua University. Tsinghua University Alumni Association profile 《徐航：一流医疗设备企业的领军人》 (https://www.tsinghua.org.cn/info/1951/18663.htm) states: “1979年考入清华大学计算机系，1984年进入清华大学电机系生物医学工程专业攻读硕士，1987年毕业。” (entered Tsinghua CS dept 1979; entered the biomedical engineering master’s programme in the EE dept in 1984; graduated 1987). The 1987 master’s is his last completed credential; he co-founded Mindray in 1991.

name: Yoshikazu Tanaka
evidence: Bachelor’s degree, Nihon University Faculty of Law, Department of Political Economy (日本大学法学部政治経済学科). DREAM GATE founder interview profile (https://www.dreamgate.gr.jp/contents/case/interview/35406) states: “1977年、東京都生まれ。日本大学法学部政治経済学科在学中、仲間と共にインターネットサービスの研究を本格的にスタート。1999年に大学を卒業し…” (“graduated from university in 1999”). Corroborated by STARTUP DB officer profile (https://startup-db.com/officers/yG7X9oaTe4emp1qD): “日本大学法学部卒業。1999年ソニーコミュニケーションネットワークに入社。” No further formal credential; he joined Sony Communication Network the same year.

name: Kosuke Sogo
evidence: Bachelor’s degree, Nihon University College of Commerce (日本大学商学部). Sogo’s own author profile on ITmedia Alternative Blog (オルタナティブ・ブロガー 十河 宏輔 プロフィール, https://blogs.itmedia.co.jp/kosukesogo/bprofile.html) states verbatim: 「1987年4月7日生　香川県出身 2010年 日本大学商学部卒業」. Corroborated by the shachomeikan.jp CEO profile (https://shachomeikan.jp/industry_article/2300): 「2010年、サイバーエージェントグループだった株式会社マイクロアドに新卒入社しました」 (joined MicroAd as a new graduate in 2010). No later credential; he founded AdAsia in 2016.

name: Kirsten Green
evidence: Sources agree she holds a BA in business economics from UCLA (Wikipedia: “She attended the University of California Los Angeles, where she obtained a degree in business economics”, https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kirsten_Green; Forerunner team page and Forbes repeat the degree) but no source located in this pass states a graduation year. Aggregator career data placing her at Deloitte & Touche from 1993 was not used, since deriving a graduation year from a first-job year would be an inference. Two further attempts (Wikipedia, targeted year-specific web search over Forbes/Generalist/C Magazine profiles) failed; recorded as unknown rather than inferred.

name: Ann Miura-Ko
evidence: PhD, Department of Management Science and Engineering, Stanford University. Stanford Digital Repository record for her dissertation (https://purl.stanford.edu/nm984rf7823) gives author “Reiko Ann Miura-Ko”, title “Modeling and mitigation of information technology risks”, and the degree statement “Thesis (Ph. D.)--Stanford University, 2010”; the full text is at https://stacks.stanford.edu/file/druid:nm984rf7823/FInal%20RAM-Ko%20Dissertation-augmented.pdf. The PhD is her last credential (Yale BS in electrical engineering, class of 1998, per Yale’s trustee listing “Ann Miura-Ko, ’98 B.S., Ph.D.”, https://www.yale.edu/board-trustees/current-trustees/ann-miura-ko).

name: Bom Kim
evidence: Bachelor’s degree (A.B., government/political science), Harvard College. The Harvard Crimson, “Grads Launch Alum Magazine”, 27 September 2006 (https://www.thecrimson.com/article/2006/9/27/grads-launch-alum-magazine-with-sections/) states: “The magazine was founded by Bom Kim ’00, who now serves as its president” and “Dan Loss ’00” — the Crimson’s ’00 notation is Harvard’s class-year convention, i.e. the class of 2000. Corroborated by Korean Wikipedia / 나무위키 profiles of 김범석 (1978) stating he graduated from Harvard’s politics department in 2000 (https://ko.wikipedia.org/wiki/%EA%B9%80%EB%B2%94%EC%84%9D_(1978%EB%85%84)). He later enrolled at Harvard Business School but dropped out in his second semester (en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bom_Kim), so the 2000 A.B. is the last credential actually completed.
